description: This file defines a console command class 'ToggleSystemCheckScreenCommand' for the OrangeHRM system, enabling toggling of the system check screen via CLI. It includes methods for command configuration and execution, utilizing traits and services from the framework, and references Symfony Console components.

classes.name: ToggleSystemCheckScreenCommand
classes.description: A console command class to enable or disable the system check screen in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the command name string used to invoke this command.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command description and options for CLI interface.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Handles the command logic for toggling the system check screen based on input options.
